hints.sentence: Each state records only a share of the people who move in and a share of its own people who move out, a different share in each state, so no host's arrivals table is the number who arrived.
People who leave a host mostly leave no record there, so its departures table is a fraction of the exits, a different fraction in each host.
The partners' tables stop at 2023, and 2024 to 2026 are seen only by Orlava's own register, which catches a fraction of the moves.

judgments.name: a host's arrivals table is that host's share of the citizens who arrived; the shares come from the two reports of every flow, and their level from Orlava's census table against its own register
a host's exits are what its two censuses, the corrected arrivals and the births and deaths leave; its departures table is a share of them
the moves of 2024 to 2026 come from Orlava's register, at the share of each host's moves it caught in the years both sides report

the tables, the register and the censuses on one footing: three state codings to one, the latest release of a table, a repeated register event counted once, the state read from the clerk's text where the code is blank, the year of the move

a population at a date rebuilt from a count and the events after it, and checked against the next count
the establishment in force reproduced from the 2021 census counts
several windows tried for a carried value, a hold-out on the latest years and a stress on a fitted rate
